title: Universal delta-functor embedding for quasi-coherent modules
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact scheme over a field k with affine diagonal [def-weil-field] [def-pc-scheme], and let F be a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. There is a monomorphism F \to F' of quasi-coherent O_X-modules such that H^p(X,F') = 0 for every p >= 1.
